title: The fold-only proof (old-hash-spliced dump == old golden tick-1) is a one-time blessing-time verification, not a durable test
evidence: PR body: "Fold-only proof (boot): the new tick-1 state dump under the new code, with the OLD hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40), FNV-hashes to the OLD golden tick-1 exactly (`6c24e9cec592aece`)". The only durable check is check_manifest: "if m.catalog_hash != catalog_hash { append(fails, fmt.tprintf("T1: catalog drift — manifest %016x vs current %016x (re-bless deliberately)", m.catalog_hash, catalog_hash)) }" plus the per-tick compare and "replay gate: the blessed log must re-sim the live hashes bit-for-bit". The re-blessed golden itself reads "catalog_hash 250679b1940fb87b" with all 1400 tick hashes replaced — the splice arithmetic is never re-executed by any test.
detail: The fold-only claim (re-bless is attributable solely to the catalog-hash bytes) is proven once at bless time. The durable proxy is the T2 zero-tolerance pixel compare (all non-node_health frames byte-identical each harness run), which guards behaviour but cannot re-prove the splice equality.
recommended_fix: Accept as-is or add a harness `fold-check` mode that splices the prior catalog_hash into a fresh dump and asserts the old golden tick-1 hash, runnable at re-bless time.

title: Small_Biz/Campus primitive-fallback render path has zero automated coverage (harness refuses fallback captures by design)
evidence: draw_building: "if role == .Small_Biz || role == .Campus { // 5.11 fallback: flat-roof blocks (office / campus) — a DISTINCT shape from the peaked-roof house (E9.1 even on the primitive path)". Harness render_setup: "if !rnd.sprites_load(&rc.view.sprites) { fmt.eprintln("harness: sprite sheet failed to load (assets/sprites) — refusing to capture with fallback primitives"); os.exit(2) }". The app path (app/main.odin:266-267) instead logs and continues: "app: sprite sheet failed to load (assets/sprites) - falling back to the primitive buildings".
detail: The new E9.1 fallback shapes are reachable only in the app's degraded (missing-sheet) mode; no golden can exercise them because the harness treats sprite-load failure as fatal. The 'distinct shape without the sheet' claim is code-inspected, not tested.
recommended_fix: Optional: add a harness flag (e.g. --no-sprites) that forces the fallback and blesses one terminal_types fallback frame, or document the fallback as untested degraded mode.

title: test_catalog (the unit-test mirror of data/*.json) is not pinned to the real data — 5.11 widened the mirror without a parity check
evidence: "A minimal self-contained catalog (mirrors data/*.json values) so the unit tests don't touch the filesystem — core is pure (ODN-1). The hash just has to be consistent within a run" ... "TEST_CATALOG_HASH :: u64(0x0123456789ABCDEF)" ... "// 5.11: the class analogues (mirror data/node_types.json — the per-type profile is throughput_units + demand_weight...)" followed by small_biz (20, era 2) and campus (150, era 3) appended to the mirror. No test loads data/*.json and compares against test_catalog.
detail: test_terminal_class_profiles / test_credit_accrue_and_max pin the profile table against the in-code mirror, not the shipped data files. A future tuning story that edits data/*.json without updating the mirror passes all unit tests; only the opaque catalog_hash binding (gate 4) catches it.
recommended_fix: Add a harness-side parity test that loads data/*.json and asserts node_types/demand equal the test_catalog rows (or at least that the real catalog folds to the blessed 250679b1940fb87b).

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: The chunk's behaviour (catalog fold + 1400 re-blessed tick hashes) is fully traced: harness run (ci-local gate 4) re-sims juice and check_manifest binds catalog_hash 250679b1940fb87b + every per-tick hash; the replay gate re-sims the blessed log bit-for-bit; T2 zero-tolerance compare re-verifies the 30000/65000 ms frames each run. The underlying 5.11 behaviour is pinned directly: test_terminal_class_profiles (spectrum, selectors, envelopes), test_credit_accrue_and_max (333/1000, 2500/3000), test_growth_era_gating, test_growth_e31_validity (small_biz/campus present + valid), test_w9_surge_lands_under_caps (content_host+campus crowd), and the terminal_types.dem all-three-types T2 golden. log.bin byte-diff independently confirmed: only the 8-byte hash field (0-indexed bytes 17-24) differs. P0 100%, P1 ~100%, overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: No change required. The three notes above are optional hardening (fold-check mode, fallback capture mode, data/mirror parity test) and do not block the re-bless.
